features.name: GitHub Copilot for documentation automation
features.description: Using GitHub Copilot to generate and maintain documentation alongside code development, enabling a docs-to-code approach where documentation is created and approved early in the development process rather than at the end.
caveats: Session involves a live demo that may not have executed successfully

features.name: Docs-to-code development methodology
features.description: A new approach to development that starts with well-structured documentation and requirements, uses that documentation to guide code generation with Copilot assistance, ensuring documentation and code stay synchronized throughout the development lifecycle.
caveats: Not yet demonstrated in this window
methodology still being introduced

features.name: Spec-driven development framework
features.description: A development methodology that starts with clear specifications and uses them to guide code generation and maintain living documentation throughout the development lifecycle.
caveats: Not a new approach, originated in NASA in the 1960s-1980s

features.name: Living artifacts in repositories
features.description: Documentation artifacts stored in Git repositories that remain alive and updated throughout the development lifecycle, changing with every decision and release.
caveats: Different documentation requirements for different project types; internal vs customer projects may need different artifacts

features.name: AI agents with specification context
features.description: AI agents that rely on clear specifications to provide better solutions, avoiding unreliable rapid coding approaches when developing enterprise solutions.
caveats: Without proper specifications, AI agents can produce unreliable solutions

features.name: Living documentation in Git repository
features.description: Documentation stored in GitHub repository alongside code, updated before development, and modified with every commit. Creates an evolving record of changes and decisions throughout the project lifecycle.

features.name: Decision tracking with reviewer attribution
features.description: Every architectural decision is captured in Git commits with full history of who made the decision, when, and in what context. Code review gates help catch architectural issues before merge.
caveats: Requires discipline in commit messages and review processes

features.name: Documentation as single source of truth for agents
features.description: Specifications and documentation serve as the manifest and source of truth that drives AI agents. High quality documentation is prerequisite for agents to work well. Code is generated from documentation, not vice versa.
caveats: Documentation quality directly impacts agent effectiveness
Requires treating documentation as primary artifact

features.name: Business consultant agent
features.description: First agent in the workflow that captures messy requirements and reviews Microsoft Learn to understand what exists in Business Central and what needs customization. Prevents suggesting creation of already-existing features.
caveats: Agent does not have accountability
Requires human review of generated documents
Cannot be trusted without validation

features.name: Architect agent for specs and architecture documents
features.description: Second agent that converts user stories into technical specifications and creates architecture documents showing overall solution design and integration with extensions.
caveats: Creates overview but not complete ground details
Requires human review
Framework is flexible and may need customization

features.name: Analyst agent with SWAT analysis
features.description: Agent that creates analysis documents including SWAT analysis covering strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats of the solution. Provides customer with understanding of risks and benefits before implementation decision.
caveats: Requires human expertise to validate SWAT assessment
Important for customer go/no-go decisions

features.name: Developer agent with plans
features.description: Agent that breaks down specs into lower-level atomic task plans with specific objects to be created and triggers needed. Works with slower models due to atomic level of detail.
caveats: Sequential workflow for single user story
Can work in parallel if no dependencies
Requires review before production

features.name: GitHub Copilot skills for documentation
features.description: Structured skills that provide output schema validation and constraints for consistent documentation generation. Prevents hallucination and ensures specific output format requirements are met.
caveats: Skills approach required for consistency
Simple prompting insufficient for reliable outputs
Skills needed for both development and documentation

features.name: GitHub Copilot skills
features.description: Copilot skills provide control over AI output by allowing specification of output aspects and generation of clarifying questions, moving beyond simple prompting to structured guidance.
caveats: requires more structured setup than simple prompting

features.name: Documentation skill
features.description: A skill for covering documentation generation for development lifecycle, including user story generator, technical spec generator, architecture document generator, facility generator, change control, phase plan, and release note generator.
caveats: multiple skills can be combined into one for each document type

features.name: AL Development Collection extension
features.description: Open source community framework that provides starting point for AL development with pre-built agents, skills, and instructions that can be customized and adapted to specific needs.
caveats: may require customization
available for both on-premises and cloud

features.name: Copilot skill collection
features.description: Open source repository where developers can download free skills, upload ideas, and collaborate on documentation and development skills with community members.
caveats: community-driven maintenance

features.name: Biceps framework integration
features.description: Development framework similar to Terraform that allows deployment of resources in organization and integration with external services like SharePoint for document delivery.
caveats: used for SharePoint integration
delivers documents in Word format instead of Markdown

features.name: Symlinks for agent management
features.description: Tool that dynamically links files and folders from different repositories, allowing agents and instructions from shared frameworks to be accessed across multiple projects without duplication.
caveats: enables dynamic branch changes
supports multiple departmental frameworks

features.name: Multi-department agentic framework standardization
features.description: Approach using symlinks to maintain a standard agentic framework across development teams and departments, allowing individual repositories to reference shared agents and instructions while enabling branch switching for version control.
caveats: requires protected main branch
central repository access needed

features.name: User story generation from requirements
features.description: Automated generation of multiple user stories from initial customer requirements documents using Copilot skills, converting functional sessions into structured user story format.
caveats: requires structured initial requirements capture

features.name: Skills-based document formatting with templates
features.description: A Python script-based skill that transforms requirements and markdown documentation into well-structured word documents using templates with placeholders, supporting multiple languages.
caveats: Requires template maintenance
Requires consistent markdown input
Placeholder system requires proper setup

features.name: GitHub Actions integration for SharePoint documentation sync
features.description: Automated process that syncs generated user story documents from GitHub repository to SharePoint when changes are pushed to main branch.
caveats: Requires GitHub Actions setup
Requires SharePoint access configuration

features.name: User story decomposition from requirements
features.description: Process of breaking down large requirements documents into structured user stories with clear acceptance criteria and business value.

features.name: Architecture decision documentation with human-in-the-loop
features.description: Specification documents where architects and consultants explicitly record design decisions including enum vs table choices, flow design patterns, and architectural patterns, with agent-assisted but human-validated content.
caveats: Requires architect ownership and validation
Human decision-making is critical for correctness

features.name: Feasibility analysis and risk assessment in specifications
features.description: Detailed analysis within specification documents including hour estimations at 100 euros per person rate, SWOT analysis, and risk assessment to build customer confidence in proposed changes.
caveats: Requires accurate estimation experience
Risk assessment accuracy depends on domain knowledge

features.name: Change Control Notice with approval workflow
features.description: Summary document synthesizing architecture decisions, specifications, feasibility analysis, and risk assessment with customer approval section and mermaid diagrams for technical structure visualization.
caveats: Requires customer sign-off before implementation
Mermaid diagrams add complexity

features.name: AI model selection strategy for task complexity
features.description: Recommended practice of using strong models like Claude Opus for creating detailed specifications and task definitions, then using smaller models like Claude Haiku for implementation tasks.
caveats: Cost-benefit analysis needed for larger teams
Task specification quality critical for smaller model success

features.name: Release notes generation with AI
features.description: Automated skill that grabs all context from the repository of what has been developed and committed in each phase, generating release notes with JSON data for filling documents.
caveats: release notes are simplistic
screenshots need manual addition or external tools

features.name: Testing documentation in release notes
features.description: Release notes include testing steps section explaining how users can test the delivered features, even for simplistic phases.
caveats: limitations are documented as well

features.name: Feature limitation documentation
features.description: Release notes document limitations and development status, such as features not yet created or constraints from defined enums preventing certain status values.

features.name: Test-driven development integration
features.description: Framework encourages incorporating TDD into the development workflow where test features are created in parallel with production features.
caveats: not integrated into the current presentation scope

features.name: ALDC tool
features.description: A development tool recommended for AL development work.

features.name: AL Copilot Skills
features.description: Skills for GitHub Copilot tailored to AL development workflows.

features.name: OpenSpec framework
features.description: A framework that can be implemented through extensions or used as a foundation to create custom frameworks.

features.name: GitHub Actions for CI-CD
features.description: GitHub Actions integration for synchronizing development workflows.
caveats: synchronization takes time

features.name: Specification-driven development approach
features.description: A methodology that completes documentation and specifications before development starts, providing clear structure for features and implementation phases.
caveats: can adapt to both waterfall and agile methodologies

features.name: Automated video-to-script generation for release notes
features.description: Tools that can record a video and automatically generate a script to provide to customers as documentation.
caveats: Tools mentioned are external and not specific to Business Central

features.name: Screenshot automation in documentation workflows
features.description: Capability to automate placement of screenshots in documents, though manual screenshot capture is still required.
caveats: Manual screenshot capture still required
Automation only covers placement in documents

features.name: Jira integration with specification documents
features.description: Capability to update Jira using generated specifications through MCPs or PowerShell injection.
caveats: Requires pre-existing Jira setup
Multiple integration methods available (MCPs, PowerShell, etc.)

features.name: Branch-based specification management
features.description: Workflow where specifications are maintained on feature branches and tied to commits when merged to main branch for history tracking.
caveats: Not presented as tight integration
Branch deletion is optional but recommended for efficiency

features.name: Proof of concept approach for validation
features.description: Strategy to build and demonstrate prototypes to customers for validation before full development, with defined scope and cost agreements.
caveats: Only recommended for new or innovative technologies
Requires upfront agreement on scope, time, and cost with customer
